splash.text: A calmer money day starts with one small choice.

quotes.native: पहचान। मनी फॉलोज, भाई, मनी फॉलोज।
quotes.roman: Pehchaan. Money follows, bhai, money follows.
quotes.subtitle: Recognition first. Money follows, brother.
Money attracts money.

quotes.native: छोटे फैसले मिलकर बड़ा सुकून देते हैं।
quotes.roman: Chhote faisle milkar bada sukoon dete hain.
quotes.subtitle: A small mindful choice today makes tomorrow easier.

quotes.native: छोटे फैसले मिलकर बड़ा सुकून देते हैं।
quotes.roman: Chhote faisle milkar bada sukoon dete hain.
quotes.subtitle: Steady choices are worth noticing.

splash.native: हर रुपया एक छोटी कहानी कहता है।
splash.roman: Har rupaya ek chhoti kahani kehta hai.

quotes.subtitle: Money doesn't come for free.

quotes.native: మనం బాగున్నపుడు లెక్కలు మాట్లాడకూడదు, కష్టాల్లో ఉన్నప్పుడు విలువలు మాట్లాడకూడదు.
quotes.roman: Manam bagunapudu lekkalu matladakudadu, kastalo unnapudu viluvalu matladakudadu.
quotes.subtitle: When we are well off, we shouldn't talk about calculations; when in trouble, we shouldn't talk about values.
A small mindful choice today makes tomorrow easier.
Steady choices are worth noticing.

splash.native: ప్రతి రూపాయి ఒక చిన్న కథ చెబుతుంది.
splash.roman: Prathi rupayi oka chinna katha chebutundi.

quotes.subtitle: If you have a little money in your hands, you are its boss. If you have money up to your neck, it becomes your boss.
Everything is money.
A small mindful choice today makes tomorrow easier.
Steady choices are worth noticing.

splash.native: ஒவ்வொரு ரூபாயும் ஒரு சிறு கதையைச் சொல்கிறது.
splash.roman: Ovvoru roopaayum oru siru kathaiyai solgiradhu.

quotes.subtitle: Back off, Dinesha. (A playful dismissal.)

quotes.native: എന്റെ കയ്യിൽ പണം കായ്ക്കണ മരം ഒന്നുമില്ല.
quotes.roman: Ente kayyil panam kaykkan maram onnumilla.
quotes.subtitle: I don't have a money tree in my hand.
A small mindful choice today makes tomorrow easier.
Steady choices are worth noticing.

quotes.native: ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಿಗತ್ತೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮಗೆ ಬೇಕಾಗಿರುವುದು ಹಣ ಮಾತ್ರ.
quotes.roman: Ella sigatte. Ella. Nimagē bēkāgiruvudu haṇa mātra.
quotes.subtitle: You'll get everything. Everything. You just need money.
If you looked at your bank balance...
A small mindful choice today makes tomorrow easier.
Steady choices are worth noticing.
